<!-- Search existing issues and open PRs first. Use a specific, plain title without
     a category prefix, e.g. "Honor the requested mode in the Windows access provider". -->

## Problem

<!-- Explain the observed behavior, expected behavior, and practical impact.
     Link the relevant code at a specific revision when known. -->

## Reproduction

<!-- Include a minimal example, exact commands, and the relevant output or error.
     State the tested revision/version and relevant host, target, and tool versions.
     Distinguish an executed reproduction from a source-derived hypothesis. -->

## Scope

<!-- Describe the behavior to fix and any compatibility boundary that matters.
     Omit this section if the problem already defines the whole scope. -->

## Completion criteria

<!-- Use a short checklist of observable outcomes and regression coverage.
     Describe what should pass, not a prescribed implementation. -->
